entries.152c9b0b09c33eb5: Business of the Bank of The Ryukyus Group
entries.5baf9de6884740c1: This segment consists of consolidated subsidiary Ryukyu Lease Co., Ltd., which conducts leasing operations, among others. Ordinary income from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥19,527 million.
entries.5eacfe1f0131d7c8: This segment consists of consolidated subsidiary Riukomu Co., Ltd., which conducts IT operations, including system design and development and IT infrastructure. Ordinary income from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,997 million.
entries.cec369d6a5b5e4df: A regional bank with its head office in Naha City, Okinawa Prefecture, which provides financial services such as leasing and credit cards as a group, centered on banking operations.
entries.d691924512ae919f: The Bank conducts deposit, lending, domestic exchange, foreign exchange and securities investment operations, among others, at 75 sales outlets including its head office (of which 14 are sub-branches); this is the group's core business. It meets the funding needs of small and medium-sized enterprises and individuals in Okinawa Prefecture. Ordinary income from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥54,192 million, the largest of the segments.
entries.dc1fe5d92b5fb627: This category is not included in reportable segments and consists of research operations on industry, economy and finance, among others, conducted by consolidated subsidiary Ryugin Research Institute Co., Ltd. Ordinary income from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6 million.
entries.de1d870876a7c9ae: The Bank and six consolidated subsidiaries form the group, conducting primarily banking operations, as well as leasing, credit card, credit guarantee and IT operations, among others.
entries.dea13dca5386194d: This segment consists of consolidated subsidiaries Ryugin DC Co., Ltd. and OCS Co., Ltd., which conduct credit card operations. OCS Co., Ltd. also conducts individual credit purchase brokerage. Ordinary income from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,177 million.
entries.f498faaf1f71ca9d: This segment consists of consolidated subsidiary Ryugin Hosho Co., Ltd., which conducts guarantee operations for housing loans, among others. Ordinary income from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥421 million.
